key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats
Parts of the mangrove forests remained under water
Properties in low-lying coastal areas were destroyed
Few lives were lost after coast guards warned people to move away
evidence_snippets: Water retreated; within two hours, waves started to hit the coast
Boats lost; mangroves under water; low-lying properties destroyed; very few lives lost
missing_information: Exact casualty and damage figures not provided
